title: Neodymium-catalyzed polybutadienes
abstract: The invention relates to a linear, neodymium-catalyzed polybutadiene of high molecular weight, having a high content of cis-1,4 units of >95% and a low content of 1,2-vinyl of 1+4100 DEG C) of the polybutadiene is 70-90 and the molar mass distribution index of the polybutadiene is less than 10.
